title: Webstore customization (Page Builder widgets, theme override, source change)
summary: Three documented levels: (1) configure pages in Page Builder (CMS > Store Experience, CMS > Pages); (2) add custom Page Builder components (widgets) and override components with a theme package registered in the theme config map, with Tailwind theming; (3) change the Webstore source (pages, components, BFF route handlers, API clients). Levels 1 and 2 are documented mechanisms in the KB's Webstore Customization Guide; level 3 is a source customization with upgrade-merge cost.
when_to_use: rearrange or edit predefined commerce pages and content pages: Page Builder, no code
a new storefront component or widget; restyle or replace a component for one theme: widget plus theme override
a new BFF route, a new page flow, or a change in base logic: source change
not_for: business rules that must be identical on listing, cart and checkout: keep those in the API layer, not the UI

contract.stack: Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Nx monorepo
contract.pattern: UI -> BFF route handler (apps/webstore/src/app/api/**/route.ts) -> Znode API / custom endpoint
contract.build: npx nx lint webstore; npx nx build webstore; npx nx test webstore

documented_mechanisms.custom_widget: folder per widget under the page-builder package's base-config widgets (Config file with fields, defaultProps, label, render; Render file), registered in the base components config; every widget needs a category (addComponentToCategories) or it does not appear in the editor
documented_mechanisms.theme_override: scaffold a theme library package, add path aliases, a theme config folder with override-component-list, root-config and optional page-config-map, and register the theme in the theme config map; set DEFAULT_THEME; configure the theme in Admin first
documented_mechanisms.tailwind_theming: theme tailwind config scoped by a data-theme selector via the tailwindcss-themes plugin
documented_mechanisms.page_builder: CMS > Store Experience (predefined pages: product detail, category, brand list) and CMS > Pages (content pages); only published pages render

evidence.note: read in full 2026-10-15: widgets, theme override, Page Builder, Tailwind theming, env variable names, warnings

docs.title: Webstore Development & Page Builder Setup Guide

limitations: Do not modify existing theme folders; add a new theme or widget instead (KB warning)
Every new theme must be registered in the theme config map and its components in the override component list, or it will not load
The KB guide does not cover upgrades or merging local changes, BFF routes, code-level custom pages or deployment steps
A change to base source (level 3) has upgrade-merge cost: state it in every proposal
platform_change_if: the data the page needs is not returned by any Znode API
